result.topic_en: The page finishes a remark on unproductive scholars, then computes the integral of 1/(x^2+1) from 1 to infinity as a limit of series involving a divisor-counting function for divisors of form 4h+1 and 4h+3, and closes with notes on generalising Noether's fundamental theorem and on the class number of a module system.
